mapper.select: SELECT product_id AS productId, category_id AS categoryId, sale_type AS saleType, brand, product_name AS productName, product_name_jp AS productNameJp, price_jpy AS priceJpy, original_price_jpy AS originalPriceJpy, stock, sales_count AS salesCount, thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, status FROM PRODUCT ORDER BY product_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET category_id = #{request.categoryId}, stock = #{request.stock}, status = #{request.status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE product_id = #{productId}
